resources.string: AirPods audio switching with your Apple devices
Audio moves between the Pad, your iPhone and your Mac the way it does between Apple devices

Playing media or taking a call on the Pad moves the AirPods to it, and playing on another Apple device moves them back. Turning this on or off restarts Bluetooth, because the Pad shows the AirPods an Apple Bluetooth identity while it is on.\n\nNeeds the ALXP Bluetooth patch in this ROM. Based on LibrePods.
